Moreno highlighted on X that Bitcoin’s Bull Score Index has risen to 80, flashing “Extra Bullish” sentiment. Back in May, at the same price, the score was only 50 and labeled "Neutral."

The Bull Score Index measures Bitcoin’s overall market cycle phase and ranges from 0 to 100. Scores above 60 are seen as bullish, indicating sustainable upward momentum and favorable market conditions.
The composite indicator measures network demand, stablecoin liquidity and trader profit margins to determine the scores.
Fundamentally, Bitcoin > $80K right now is very different from Bitcoin > $80K back in May.
Bull Score Index (BSI) is at 80 right now (extra bullish, green), whereas it was at 50 (neutral, gray) back in May.
